title: Paraguay's President Falls Over a Bank. In 2001 Argentina Lost Five #shorts
description:
This week Paraguay's president Santiago Peña resigned in the Ueno Bank scandal, and congress voted for impeachment anyway. In December 2001, next door, Argentina froze its banks, the streets exploded, and five presidents came and went in under two weeks.
